body:
## Council question

Does it fail to trigger when a Fremen leader dies, when Fremen kills a leader or wins the battle, or another case? Compare a Fremen leader killed by an opponent with a non-Fremen leader killed in a Fremen victory.

## Source evidence

Quickstart v0.8 gives the trigger as a leader being killed, with an exception for Fremen. The published token says Fremen do not trigger it when a leader is killed. Its description says any leader, including your own, sent to the Tanks triggers it. The actor to which the Fremen exception applies is not explicit.

## Draft treatment

The supported surrounding rules are drafted. This detail is marked as awaiting council verification; no answer has been assumed.

## Sources

Quickstart v0.8, Tech Tokens; dune.zone Dreamrules Techtokens bundle, Water Stealing.

Part of #1831. Norbert will review these questions together after the full drafting pass. An answer of "I think so, but I need to verify" remains provisional.
title: Dreamrules ruling: What does the Fremen exception on Water Stealing exclude?
